info.title: Catalog API
info.description:
This documentation serves as a guide to integrate with Vivid Seats' Catalog API. The API will provide you with full access to Vivid Seats' catalog, event search and ticket listings.

The API is made up of these endpoints:

  1. Listings - Provides access to ticket listings and pricing.
  2. Performers - Provides filtered access to Performer and Opponents information.
  3. Productions - Provides filtered access to Production information with possible search provider integration.
  4. data/Productions - Provides filtered access to Production information without search provider integration.
  5. Venues - Provides filtered access to Venue information.
  6. Search-suggestions - Allows text-based searching by performer, venue and production.
  7. Categories - Lists supported categories and subcategories.
  8. Regions - Lists supported region information.
  9. Assets - Lists assets associated with category, subcategory, performer, venue, or production.
  10. Sitemap - returns sitemap information for performers and venues

API Structure

Headers

The following headers are supported:

  • X-Correlation-Id - A unique identifier that can correlate log statements from the access and application logs for a single request
  • X-App-Name - A text description of the application making the request
  • X-App-Version - A text description of the version of the application making the request
  • X-App-Context - A text description of the context of the application when it makes the request (e.g. STARTUP, PERFORMERPAGE, CHECKOUT, etc.)

Pagination

With the exception of the Listings endpoint, any endpoint that returns a list as a result will be paginated to make sure responses are easier to handle.

These endpoints will support page and pageSize as optional parameters. If not provided, endpoints will default to the first page and page size of 25 (unless otherwise specified).

Responses will include a pagination summary at their root which will include:

  • page - the current page returned
  • total - the total number of items available
  • numberOfPages - the total number of pages available given the current page size and the number of items available
  • items - the actual items in the current page
  • queryId - if search provider called, includes query id from search provider
  • indexName - if search provider called, includes index used in search provider

You can retrieve the rest of the results by increasing the page query parameter of the request until you reach the last page which is equal to the numberOfPages value.

You can also increase the page size by adjusting the pageSize parameter. Page sizes will not be allowed to exceed 1000 (unless otherwise specified).

Response

All non 200 responses will return with a standard error format including:

  • timestamp - the timestamp of the error as a long
  • statusCode - the HTTP status code
  • message - the String summary of what went wrong
  • causes - list of Strings with more detail about the error (if available)

API Endpoints

get.summary: Returns the ticket listings for the provided production(s)

parameters.name: productionId
parameters.description:
Only return listings for this list of productionIds

Maximum number of Ids: 10

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: WS User Id for modifying results (determine the pricing model/return Exclusive Listings)

parameters.name: priceGroupId
parameters.description: Price Group Id for modifying results. If both user id and price group id are set, user id has priority

parameters.name: customerIpAddress
parameters.description: Customer's ip address

parameters.name: exclusiveListings
parameters.description: Return Only the Exclusive Productions for WsUser. Requires the WsUserId

parameters.name: tagFilter
parameters.description: Search for Listings with a given Tag Filter. This filter only accepts single tag that must match exactly.

parameters.name: responseFormat
parameters.description: Return data in a specific format. Default is the legacy format which includes tickets, sections and groups.

parameters.name: includeListingTags
parameters.description: Determines whether or not listing tags are included in the response

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Determines which exclude filters you want to apply to the feed

parameters.name: aipCategory
parameters.description: All in price config category to filter by. If not provided, the default value PRODUCTION_ALL_TICKETS will be applied.

parameters.name: countryOfOrigin
parameters.description: The country code from which the search is initiated.

parameters.name: endMinOnsaleDate
parameters.description:
Only return event listings with a minimum onsale date on or before this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: startMinOnsaleDate
parameters.description:
Only return event listings with a minimum onsale date on or after this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order for the listings. Default is priceAsc (with VALUE_SCORE secondary sort). All non-price sorts use PRICE as secondary sort.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of listings to return in the response

parameters.name: sectionIds
parameters.description: Only return listings with these section IDs

parameters.name: sectionNames
parameters.description: Only return listings with these section names

parameters.name: useWebServicesPriceGroup
parameters.description: Use the same price group resolution logic as vivid-web-services for backward compatibility. Primarily used by the stats-crawler to support future web services deprecation. If true, only pass in a single production.

get.summary: Returns a list of productions that match the given set of filters. This endpoint DOES NOT return past productions. Does not delegate to search providers

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Only return productions in this list of Ids, max length 100

parameters.name: performerId
parameters.description:
Only return productions that include these performers
performerIds can be looked up from the /performers API

parameters.name: opponentId
parameters.description:
Only return productions that include this performer as the opponent to the performerId
Only one performerId must be specified
Only valid for Sports categories
performerIds can be looked up from the /performers API

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description:
Only return productions whose venue is located in this region
regionIds can be looked up from the /regions API

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that occur on or after this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that occur on or before this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description:
Only return productions with these categorization's
categoryIds can be looked up from the /categories API

parameters.name: subCategoryId
parameters.description:
Only return productions with these sub-categorization's
subcategoryIds can be looked up from the /categories API

parameters.name: venueId
parameters.description:
Only return productions that occur at this/these venue(s)
venueIds can be looked up from the /venues API

parameters.name: homeOrAway
parameters.description: Home/Away for searching

parameters.name: excludeParking
parameters.description: Do not return productions for parking lots

parameters.name: excludePerformerIds
parameters.description: Do not return productions that include these performers

parameters.name: excludeProductionIds
parameters.description: Do not return productions that include these production ids

parameters.name: hourStart
parameters.description:
Only return productions where hour is between hourStart and hourEnd inclusive where values are hours from 0 to 23 (24 hour clock).
Both values must be specified.
hourStart can be greater than hourEnd meaning an hour range across midnight into next day, so hourStart=17&hourEnd=4 includes productions with times between 5 PM and 4 AM.
Assumes hour is in venue's timezone

parameters.name: hourEnd
parameters.description:
Only return productions where hour is between hourStart and hourEnd inclusive where values are hours from 0 to 23 (24 hour clock).
Both values must be specified.
hourStart can be greater than hourEnd meaning an hour range across midnight into next day, so hourStart=17&hourEnd=4 includes productions with times between 5 PM and 4 AM.
Assumes hour is in venue's timezone

parameters.name: dayStart
parameters.description:
Only return productions where day of week 1-7 is between dayStart and dayEnd where 1 is MONDAY and 7 is SUNDAY.
Both values must be specified.
dayStart can be greater than dayEnd meaning a range across the week into the next week, so dayStart=7&dayEnd=4 means productions on days from SUNDAY through THURSDAY

parameters.name: dayEnd
parameters.description:
Only return productions where day of week 1-7 is between dayStart and dayEnd where 1 is MONDAY and 7 is SUNDAY.
Both values must be specified.
dayStart can be greater than dayEnd meaning a range across the week into the next week, so dayStart=7&dayEnd=4 means productions on days from SUNDAY through THURSDAY

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: One or more months to return

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Order the results by this attribute

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page Number for the results

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size of the results, valid range: 1 - 2500

parameters.name: onsaleStartDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that have an onsale occur on or after this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: onsaleEndDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that have an onsale occur on or before this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: presaleStartDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that have a presale occur on or after this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: presaleEndDate
parameters.description:
Only return productions that have a presale occur on or before this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: secondaryRegionId
parameters.description: Return productions within this secondaryRegionId.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only return productions which are in this city

parameters.name: includeSecondaryRegions
parameters.description: Include Secondary Region results when searching with a SecondaryRegionId

parameters.name: wsUserId
parameters.description:
Search for productions which are exclusive to a wsUser. This will return Vivid Catalog plus Exclusive Catalog.
Will also query to include exclusive listing counts.

parameters.name: minTicketCount
parameters.description: Return productions with given minimum ticket count.

parameters.name: minListingCount
parameters.description: Return productions with given minimum listing count.

parameters.name: stateCode
parameters.description: Return productions that occur within the given state.

parameters.name: minVenueRank
parameters.description: Filters based on a venue's rank

parameters.name: minPerformerRank
parameters.description: Filters based on a performer's rank

parameters.name: minAllTimePerformerRank
parameters.description: Filters based on a performer's all time rank

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Return productions within this postal code.

parameters.name: searchAnalyticsUserToken
parameters.description: Return productions that occur with this searchAnalyticsUserToken.

parameters.name: fromLocation
parameters.description:
Search for Productions from the given Lat/Long or IP address within the radius(meters) given.
Requires the radius parameter.
Format for LatLong: lat;longFormat for IP-Address: X.X.X.X

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search for Productions within the radius (meters) given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit response total to 1000 to match catalog search service

parameters.name: distinct
parameters.description: Return only the first production (by sort order) of productions that match the given set of filters and are distinct for each unique venue and event (performer) combination.

parameters.name: countryOfOrigin
parameters.description: The country code from which the search is initiated.

parameters.name: endMinOnsaleDate
parameters.description:
Only return events with a minimum onsale date on or before this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: startMinOnsaleDate
parameters.description:
Only return events with a minimum onsale date on or after this day

Format: yyyy-MM-dd

parameters.name: tagFilter
parameters.description:
Search for Productions with a given Tag Filter. This filter uses and/or logic. But not OR of ANDS.
EX: TAG1 AND TAG2
EX: TAG1 AND (TAG2 OR TAG3)
but not: TAG OR (TAG AND TAG)

parameters.name: secondaryTagFilter
parameters.description:
Search for Productions with a given secondary Tag Filter. This filter uses and/or logic. But not OR of ANDS.
EX: TAG1 AND TAG2
EX: TAG1 AND (TAG2 OR TAG3)
but not: TAG OR (TAG AND TAG)

parameters.name: minListingPriceCeiling
parameters.description: Return productions less than this listing price.

parameters.name: minListingPriceFloor
parameters.description: Return productions more than this listing price.

parameters.name: priceGroupId
parameters.description: Return pricing data against this priceGroupId. This is field is ignored if wsUserId is provided.

400.description: Filter information provided was not valid.
